entities.name: Mindosz
entities.description: An unlucky Izzet magelord titled Heretic, immolated by Niv-Mizzet for claiming mizzium could be melted.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Firemind, dragon leader of the Izzet who killed Mindosz.

entities.name: Mizzium
entities.description: A metal said to be impervious.

events.summary: Mindosz opposed Niv-Mizzet, claiming mizzium could be melted, and was immolated by the Firemind's breath in 3203 Z.C.
events.quote: Mindosz, earning the title Heretic, was immolated by the Firemind's breath in 3203 Z.C.

relations.note: He immolated Mindosz with dragon fire.
